summary: Phase 21 implements fault-tolerant render jobs at the Blender adapter boundary. ChunkSizeScheduler sizes chunks from MEASURED render time and recovery overhead (0.5 s/frame, 10 s overhead, 10% budget -> 200 frames) under the episode -> scene -> shot -> frame chunk job model; every chunk pins scene/shot/profile/asset hashes, frame range, Blender/GPU, attempt and output hashes. LeaseRegistry reserves the idempotency key BEFORE any side effect (duplicate dispatch rejected: True), and owner transfer issues a fresh fencing token that fences the stale worker out of every later publish (True). FramePublishValidator never completes 0-byte, undecodable, wrong-dimension or wrong-hash frames; publish is a fenced, atomic temp->final rename. RenderRecoveryCoordinator reconciles worker PID/lease/frame manifest after a kill mid-chunk, transfers the lease to the successor and resumes from the next valid frame (28 of 26-30 in the recovery receipt), restarting the chunk only when input hashes changed. RetryClassifier separates OOM (retry + Phase 20 mitigation replan), Blender crash (bounded retry), timeout (smaller chunk), and deterministic bad asset / disk full / user cancel / unknown (no blind retry). Test matrix: 192 passed, 0 failed; Ruff passed.

backlog_completion.1_chunk_size_scheduler: DONE - ChunkSizeScheduler derives chunk frames from measured seconds-per-frame and recovery overhead under a configurable overhead-fraction budget; RenderJobPlanner builds the episode->scene->shot->chunk job model with fully pinned chunks
backlog_completion.2_idempotency_reservation_and_lease: DONE - LeaseRegistry.acquire reserves the idempotency key before any side effect and rejects duplicate dispatch while the lease is active; one worker owns a chunk via an unforgeable fencing token with lease expiry
backlog_completion.3_atomic_publish_validation: DONE - fenced publish validates non-empty/decodable/dimension/hash on the temp file before an atomic rename; 0-byte, undecodable, wrong-dimension and wrong-hash frames are never completed
backlog_completion.4_crash_reconcile_and_resume: DONE - RenderRecoveryCoordinator reconciles worker liveness, lease state and the frame manifest; a dead/stale worker's lease transfers to the successor and rendering resumes from the next valid frame; partial reuse only when ALL input hashes still match
backlog_completion.5_stale_worker_fencing: DONE - owner transfer replaces the fencing token; the stale worker's publish raises StaleWorkerPublishError and nothing is written
backlog_completion.6_retry_classification: DONE - RetryClassifier separates OOM, Blender crash, bad asset, timeout, disk full and user cancel via deterministic marker tables + exit codes + cancel/timeout flags
backlog_completion.7_oom_replan_no_useless_retry: DONE - OOM is retryable with a replan (Phase 20 mitigation first step + 0.5x chunk size); deterministic bad asset, disk full and user cancel are never retried; attempts are bounded per cause
